title: Contact Us
description: Reach out to Moving Mountains Counseling & Wellness in Princeton, MA. We're in-network with BCBS and offer telehealth and in-person therapy. We reply within one business day.

sections.headline: Reach out. Relief starts with a conversation.
sections.body: If you'd like to talk through what's been weighing on you, you're welcome to call us or send a message using the form. We do our best to reply within one business day. No pressure, no scripts — just a real person ready to listen.
